name: get_active_context
description: Project + file the user has open in OpenDesign right now. Returns {active:false, hint:"..."} when no project is active so the agent can ask the user to interact with OpenDesign (the active context expires ~5 minutes after the last user interaction). Most tools default to this when project is omitted, so you rarely need to call this directly.

pluginWorkflowId.description: Opaque workflow id issued by the local OpenDesign MCP after the first attributed call. Reuse it for later plugin-attributed calls; never invent or display it.
